points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable source CMake build exited 0 in network-disabled cfd-bench with configured external root; run 02 also uses its documented CFD_HEADER_ROOT. No host credentials or network exposed.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Required solve --case --output form is in README and submitted command records; missing-file case exits nonzero with clear error in isolated executable. Standalone --help is unsupported, which is not a required CLI command; other malformed inputs unverified.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: CMake builds separate mesh, partition, config, flux, solver and output units; reconstruction and nonlinear algorithms are concentrated in lusgs_solver.cpp.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: CMake builds the submitted C++ core and links MPI/CGNS/METIS/HDF5, with no inspected invocation of an external CFD solver. Per trust policy, no authorship or external similarity search was performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.cpp reads configured mesh and boundary settings rather than two fixed mesh filenames. General nonbenchmark case behavior was not independently exercised.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:110 calls METIS; lusgs_solver.cpp:185–218 exchanges halo state and gradients with sparse Alltoallv counts and :515–517,1046 globally reduces residual/force. Submitted short np2/8 cylinder and np2/4/8 NACA comparisons are close; np1 and independent full convergence remain unverified.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:303–410 implements limited reconstruction and positivity fallback, with first-order startup and 0.1 slope cap for steady cases. Report.tex:458–485 identifies excessive laminar/cylinder drag; no stress testing was run.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight original packages and report pass the structural validator; report documents short rank checks and numerical limitations. No independent grid-order test or full solver rerun was performed.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Clean immutable CMake build succeeds; solver/report and source are organized separately. Generated result data were excluded from the curated tip but retained in contestant history.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex describes compressible equations; flux.hpp and lusgs_solver.cpp:422–497 implement conservative face and physical-time residual terms. Independent analytical verification was not performed.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_mesh.cpp:148–275 reads CGNS zones and connectivity and :324 handles TRI_3/QUAD_4; unsupported general MIXED elements and untested multi-zone variants limit confidence. partition.cpp constructs a METIS cell graph.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:422–497 assembles numerical face fluxes with equal/opposite cell contributions and adds BDF time terms; globally reduced residual norms at :500–517. No independent order verification.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: flux.hpp provides Roe and Rusanov paths, selected by numericalFlux, with source positivity fallback. The delivered steady results are limited by low limiter cap, not proof of a broken flux.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:231–259 implements farfield, slip and no-slip wall states; :432 onward uses them for face fluxes. Surface rows show boundary velocity checks; no independent boundary test was repeated.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:262–300 gradients, :303–410 limiter and reconstructed states; steady metadata reports second-order stage with slope cap 0.1 after first-order startup. This materially limits spatial accuracy.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:303–396 bounds slopes and includes positivity fallback; wall/small-cell first-order behavior and steady cap 0.1 strongly damp reconstruction.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: flux.hpp:263–290 forms stress and heat flux, but lusgs_solver.cpp:1014–1046 integrates the full stress traction in viscous force, with no tangential projection. The rubric requires a tangential skin-friction split. Wall shear/drag accuracy is also materially limited.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:530–666 assembles approximate block Jacobian and SGS, with source time step controls and steady CFL cap 0.1. Independent solver-order study was not performed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: lusgs_solver.cpp:480–497 adds BDF residual and :1500–1546 runs inner updates and shifts physical histories after a step. Re200 metadata gives dt=0.01, t=300, inner convergence fraction 0.9983; report admits strong raw frequency noise and diffuse wake. No unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:110 calls METIS; lusgs_solver.cpp:185–218 communicates halo state/gradients with sparse Alltoallv counts; np2/8 cylinder and np2/4/8 NACA continuation force comparisons are close, but no np1 result was delivered.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: The explicit validator passes all eight workspace packages/report. Structural success does not establish correct tangential force decomposition or physics; output histories/field files remain excluded from immutable tip.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Explicit official validator invocation on all eight canonical workspace result directories and the report exited 0. This confirms structure only, not physical correctness.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: All eight result packages are readable and Re200 reaches t=300, but late-time force plot is dominated by initial transient and cannot display claimed oscillations. Very high reported laminar and cylinder drag materially limits result confidence.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: M0.15 laminar Cd=0.521, M0.8 laminar Cd=0.192 and cylinder Re20 Cd=4.63 are acknowledged in report.tex:478–485 as far above stated comparisons; Re200 has noisy raw frequency and diffuse wake.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report includes case-specific force, residual and computed field figures, but many are small in the 12-page PDF. Re200 force history uses a full scale dominated by an initial Cd spike and does not reveal late-time lift/drag periodicity.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report documents small-cell/limiter limits and unusually high drag, plus Re200 raw-frequency noise. Some images are small and late transient force behavior cannot be read; source viscous force integrates full stress rather than the rubric-required tangential split.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Workspace figure_manifest.csv maps each case figure to variables and data; final forces were checked against CSV. Raw datasets are absent from the curated tip and complete pixel-to-field fidelity was not independently verified.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Clean documented build 4/4; required solve form used in submitted commands 1.5/2; eight packages/report pass explicit validator 2/2; missing-file error verified but other bad-input paths not exercised 1/2.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS zones and boundary mapping 3/4 (cgns_mesh.cpp:148–275), geometry 2/2, mixed/multizone support 1/2 (TRI_3/QUAD_4 recognized; general MIXED section unverified/unsupported), adjacency 2/2 (partition.cpp METIS graph).

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual 4/5 (lusgs_solver.cpp:422–497), Roe/Rusanov flux 3.5/4, farfield/slip 2.5/3 and no-slip 3/3 (:231–259 and face assembly); independent accuracy and full wall tests were not repeated.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: Reconstruction 2.5/4 and limiter 2/3 (:262–410): first-order startup and final steady limiter cap 0.1 substantially damp slopes; positivity fallback 2/2; independent smooth second-order evidence 0/1.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Velocity/temperature gradients 2.5/3 and stress/heat flux 2.5/3 (flux.hpp:263–290), no-slip wall 2/2, tangential force split 0/2: lusgs_solver.cpp:1014–1046 integrates full shearTraction stress vector rather than projecting tangentially. Large reported wall drag also limits credibility.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: Steady 3/4: implicit march with disclosed severe CFL caps; linear method 3.5/4: block Jacobian and SGS lusgs_solver.cpp:530–666. Transient 3/4: dt=0.01 and t=300 with BDF residual and inner stepping; observed full residual target count 3/3 from submitted metadata (0.9983). Wake credibility and plotting are judged separately.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS 2/2 partition.cpp:110; neighbor halo 3/3 lusgs_solver.cpp:185–218; global reductions 2/2 :515–517,1046; output 1/1; rank consistency 0/2: short np2/8 cylinder and np2/4/8 NACA comparisons are close but no np1 and no independent full-rank convergence.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Inviscid 1.5/2: readable cases but M0.15 drag drift and M0.8 lift asymmetry; laminar 0.5/2: M0.15 and M0.8 high Cd explicitly admitted; Re20 0.5/2: reported Cd 4.63 versus report comparison near 2; Re200 0.5/2: t=300 and inner controls but noisy raw frequency/diffuse wake and no readable late drag plot; fields 1/1; rank comparisons 0.5/1: only short np2–8 continuations.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Equations 0.75/1; histories 0.5/1 (Re200 late forces not readable); fields 0.5/1 (small report figures, diffuse wake); analysis 0.5/1 (unusually high drag and noisy frequency disclosed); traceability 0.25/1 (workspace manifest exists, raw sources unavailable in curated tip and pixel correspondence not independently established).

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Equation interface 1/2, boundary extension 0.5/1, 2-D mesh abstractions 0.5/1, organized source units 1/1; solver is largely specialized to 2-D compressible gas.
